annotation.title_clean: The Supply of Machinery (Safety) (Amendment etc.) and the EU Machinery Regulation (Enforcement etc. in Northern Ireland) Regulations 2026
annotation.title_en: The Supply of Machinery (Safety) (Amendment etc.) and the EU Machinery Regulation (Enforcement etc. in Northern Ireland) Regulations 2026
annotation.authors_or_issuer: King's Printer of Acts of Parliament; Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade
annotation.summary_en: UK statutory instrument implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (Machinery Regulation) in Northern Ireland under the Windsor Framework and amending the Great Britain 2008 machinery regulations to accept compliance with it. It sets conformity assessment, UK(NI) marking, enforcement authorities and criminal offences, effective 20 January 2027.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies EU Machinery Regulation 2023/1230 in Northern Ireland from 20 January 2027
GB 2008 machinery regulations amended so machinery meeting the EU Machinery Regulation can be placed on the GB market
UK(NI) indication required next to CE marking where UK notified bodies assess conformity
HSENI and district councils designated as market surveillance enforcers
Contravening economic operator obligations is an offence, up to two years' imprisonment on indictment
